Two-sided certificate only. Primary model comparisons are marked. The source audit totals (reference_comparisons, reference_disagreements, maximum_cell_disagreement_rate, audit_cells) aggregate BOTH alpha levels and are repeated in each alpha row: deduplicate units before summing them. Accuracy and abstention columns are alpha-specific. Cached draws are reused across test cells. Extra sparsity audit groups are retained separately. A comparison bound includes reference uncertainty; it is not an adversarial robustness radius.

conventions.accuracy: Fraction in [0,1] unless a column ends in _pp or _percent.
conventions.sample_sd: Across seeds, denominator n-1; not the standard error.
conventions.gap: sampled accuracy minus mean-field accuracy, in percentage points.
conventions.paired_change: Intervention minus comparator for the same dataset, architecture and seed.
conventions.missing_values: Empty cells are unavailable or inapplicable, never zero.
conventions.certificate_accuracy: Correct and accepted predictions divided by all evaluated inputs; abstentions remain in the denominator.
conventions.certificate_disagreements: Disagreements between accepted decisions and the resolved reference decision; they are not automatically violations of a probabilistic bound.

matched_slope_protocol.selection: Highest mean-field validation accuracy evaluated at beta=5; strict improvement and earliest tie. All validation-selected checkpoints sealed before test evaluation. Previously studied SHD test data; no unseen-test claim.
matched_slope_protocol.optimizer: AdamW; learning rate 0.001; weight decay 0.0001; cosine schedule over 100 epochs; batch size 128; gradient clip 1.
matched_slope_protocol.checkpoint_availability: Hashes identify the archived selected checkpoints; hashes alone do not supply the weights.
